tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently purchased a piece of furniture for your dorm room from an online store called 'Home Comforts.' When the item arrived, you discovered. Write an email to the customer service representative, Ms. Brown.
bullets: Describe the item you purchased and the damage it sustained.
Explain why you are disappointed with the situation.
Request a replacement or a refund for the damaged item.
tasks.to: the customer service representative, Ms. Brown
tasks.subject: Furniture Delivery Problem
